title: Downloads run one after another
code:
import asyncio


async def download(url):
    await asyncio.sleep(1)
    return url


async def main(urls):
    results = []
    for url in urls:
        #? perché ci mette un secondo per ogni url?
        results.append(await download(url))
    return results
fix_lines: results = await asyncio.gather(*(download(url) for url in urls))
rubric: Explains that awaiting inside the loop waits for each download before starting the next. May name asyncio.gather, without writing the rewritten main.
